# Zstore AI

> Zstore AI is the independent web design and development studio of Zvi Moshe, based in Tel Aviv, working with clients worldwide. One person designs and hand-codes websites, landing pages, UI/UX and integrations: no templates, no page builders, no hand-offs. Contact: zstore.ai295@gmail.com · WhatsApp +972 58 729 2029.

Zstore AI is a one-person studio: the person you brief (Zvi Moshe) is the person who designs and builds the site. Founded in 2024. Projects are quoted at a fixed price based on the agreed scope, and every launch includes 30 days of post-launch care. Zvi works in English and Hebrew and replies within one business day.

The canonical site of the English-language studio is https://zstore-ai.com/. Zvi also runs a separate Hebrew-language site at https://zstore-ai.co.il/ (linked from the footer credit).

## Services

- Web experiences: custom websites and landing pages, responsive development
- Digital product design: UI/UX, prototyping, design systems
- Code & connections: integrations, payment flows, forms, WordPress and CMS
- Refinement & care: performance, accessibility, SEO foundations, ongoing support
